draft.subject: Getting your first Wrenfield project started
draft.body:
Hi Felix,

Since our getting started call last week, I wanted to check in. The easiest first step is creating a first project — in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so everything else hangs off that. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I can walk through setting up your first project with you live and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
